# odinex_image (Data Source)

Looks up an image (system, app, snapshot or backup) by ID, by name, or by type and label selector. With several matches, set `most_recent = true` to pick the newest one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "odinex_image" "ubuntu" {
  name = "ubuntu-24.04"
}

# Newest snapshot with a label.
data "odinex_image" "golden" {
  with_type     = "snapshot"
  with_selector = "image=golden"
  most_recent   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) ID of the image.
- `include_deprecated` (Boolean) Also consider deprecated images.
- `location` (String) Only images available in this location.
- `most_recent` (Boolean) Pick the newest image when several match.
- `name` (String) Name of the image, e.g. `ubuntu-24.04`.
- `with_architecture` (String) Only images of this architecture, e.g. `x86`.
- `with_selector` (String) Label selector, e.g. `env=prod,role`.
- `with_status` (List of String) Only images with one of these statuses, e.g. `["available"]`.
- `with_type` (String) Only images of this type: `system`, `app`, `snapshot` or `backup`.

### Read-Only

- `architecture` (String) Architecture, e.g. `x86`.
- `created` (String) Creation date (RFC 3339).
- `created_from` (Number) Server the snapshot or backup was made from.
- `deprecated` (String) Deprecation date (RFC 3339), empty if not deprecated.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `disk_size` (Number) Minimum disk size in GB.
- `image_size` (Number) Size in GB (snapshots).
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels.
- `locations` (List of String) Locations where the image can be used.
- `os_flavor` (String) OS flavor, e.g. `ubuntu`.
- `os_version` (String) OS version.
- `status` (String) Status of the image.
- `type` (String) `system`, `app`, `snapshot` or `backup`.
